description: State Planning Policy 5.3 Land Use Planning in the Vicinity of Jandakot Airport (DPLH-047) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Planning, Lands and Heritage. The policy applies to land in the vicinity of Jandakot airport, which is, or may in the future, be affected by aircraft noise. Opened in 1963, Jandakot Airport is the principal general aviation airport in Western Australia, and is one of the busiest airfields and largest aviation training bases in Australia. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Planning, Lands and Heritage. Its tags are Airport, Jandakot, Planning, SPP, SPP 5.3. It offers 9 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom_active_acceptance. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
